title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・“勝ちたい”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City wins the Tenno Sho (Spring) against Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching Tamamo Cross display raw frustration, Gold City realizes just how preoccupied she's been by everyone's opinion of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hasn't been listening to her own heart. But now, she hears it scream with the simple desire to both run and win more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racecourse is where she wants to be, and her manager, moved to tears by the heartfelt joy she displayed on the track, agrees that she should continue racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen, the final race of the Senior Spring Triple Crown and our chance to show Tamamo Cross what Gold City's really made of!
